process.title: 十进制时间互转组件 decimaltime.py
process.scope: Owns only decimaltime.py and tests/test_decimaltime.py (both new files). Does not touch bell.py, tapcode.py, or any existing file; no imports beyond the standard library; no imports from the other two modules.
process.task:
Implement the decimal-time conversion component exactly to the work order spec, creating only two new files: decimaltime.py and tests/test_decimaltime.py. Do not modify any existing file; use only the standard library; do not import bell or tapcode.

Fixed decimal-time definition: one day = 10 decimal hours, each decimal hour = 100 decimal minutes, each decimal minute = 100 decimal seconds (a full day = 100000 decimal seconds corresponding to 86400 regular seconds). All conversions truncate (floor), never round.

to_decimal(h, m, s) -> tuple[int, int, int]: inputs must be numeric (int/float, bool rejected), non-numeric raises TypeError; ranges 0 <= h < 24, 0 <= m < 60, 0 <= s < 60, out of range raises ValueError. Convert seconds elapsed in the day to decimal seconds by ratio, truncate, then split into (decimal hours, decimal minutes, decimal seconds).

from_decimal(dh, dm, ds) -> tuple[int, int, int]: inputs must be int (bool rejected), non-int raises TypeError; ranges 0 <= dh < 10, 0 <= dm < 100, 0 <= ds < 100, out of range raises ValueError. Inverse conversion, truncate, then split into (h, m, s).

Acceptance examples, every one must have a corresponding test case in tests/test_decimaltime.py:
- to_decimal(0, 0, 0) == (0, 0, 0)
- to_decimal(12, 0, 0) == (5, 0, 0)
- to_decimal(6, 0, 0) == (2, 50, 0)
- to_decimal(18, 0, 0) == (7, 50, 0)
- to_decimal(0, 0, 1) == (0, 0, 1) (truncation)
- to_decimal(23, 59, 59) == (9, 99, 98)
- to_decimal(1, 0, 0) == (0, 41, 66)
- to_decimal(0, 36, 0) == (0, 25, 0)
- from_decimal(0, 0, 0) == (0, 0, 0)
- from_decimal(5, 0, 0) == (12, 0, 0)
- from_decimal(2, 50, 0) == (6, 0, 0)
- from_decimal(9, 99, 99) == (23, 59, 59)
- from_decimal(0, 0, 1) == (0, 0, 0) (truncation)
- from_decimal(1, 0, 0) == (2, 24, 0)
- Round-trips: from_decimal(*to_decimal(12, 0, 0)) == (12, 0, 0); to_decimal(*from_decimal(5, 0, 0)) == (5, 0, 0); to_decimal(*from_decimal(0, 25, 0)) == (0, 25, 0)
- to_decimal(24, 0, 0), to_decimal(0, 60, 0), to_decimal(0, 0, 60), to_decimal(-1, 0, 0), from_decimal(10, 0, 0), from_decimal(0, 100, 0), from_decimal(0, 0, -1) each raise ValueError
- to_decimal("12", 0, 0), to_decimal(True, 0, 0), from_decimal(1.5, 0, 0) each raise TypeError

Include a test case for each acceptance example above (all listed value, round-trip, ValueError and TypeError cases).

Checks (run from repository root):
1. python3 -m pytest tests/test_decimaltime.py -q
2. python3 -m pytest tests/ -q
